faqs.q: Sec. 42-62. - I.F.C. Section 510.5.1, Approval prior to installation.
faqs.a:
Section 510.5.1. Approval prior to installation
, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"
510.5.1. Approval prior to installation.
Amplification systems capable of operating on frequencies licensed to any public
                  safety agency by the FCC shall not be installed without prior coordination and approval
                  of the City's radio system administrator and local fire code official."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
